_meta.purpose: Durable roster-wide Winners/Unforced-Errors store from api-tennis box scores; feeds the archetype W/UE axis (Attacking-Baseliner winner-volume flag + Solid-Baseliner clean-error gate) at ~4x the Match-Charting sample.
_meta.denominator: Points/"Total Points Won".stat_total (service+return points), same convention as the Match-Charting corpus
_meta.literalZeroRule: A literal 0 for Winners or Unforced Errors is MISSING, not a real zero; such player-matches are excluded and tallied in excludedZeroMatches.
_meta.incremental: Cached per (eventType,windowStart) under apitennis-wue-cache/. Windows older than 4d are settled and never re-pulled; live windows re-pull after 12h. Re-run advances the cursor to today automatically.
_meta.reproduce: node backfill-wue-history.js  (incremental) | --full to re-scan | --from=YYYY-MM-DD to move the start cursor
